intro: Algeria is the largest country in Africa, and over four-fifths of it is the Sahara Desert.

chapters.title: Coast, mountains and desert
text: Most people live on the green Mediterranean coast and in the Tell Atlas. South of the Saharan Atlas lies the vast desert, with sand seas and the Hoggar and Tassili mountains. Mount Tahat is the highest peak at 3,003 m.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The coast has a Mediterranean climate; the Sahara is one of the hottest, driest places on Earth.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Algeria's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
